summary.plain: The physicists who built and ran the MINOS experiment, and its follow-on run MINOS+, sending a neutrino beam from Fermilab to a detector 735 kilometres away in Minnesota from 2005 to 2016.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating MINOS (2005-2012) and its continuation MINOS+ (2013-2016) on the Fermilab NuMI beamline, with near and far magnetised steel-scintillator detectors at Fermilab and the Soudan Underground Laboratory.
